To repaint kitchen cabinets, start by preparing the area and gathering necessary tools. Remove or clean existing materials if needed. Patching a pantry door: Materials needed: cleaner, scraper, sanding block, patching compound or filler, putty knife, primer, finish paint or sealant, brush, rags, protective tape.
